author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for iRacing Arcade, an arcade racing simulation game developed by Original Fire Games and iRacing. Players will form a racing team like no other to take on multiple tracks, compete across multiple modes, and customize cars with unlocks and upgrades. iRacing Arcade is available now for PC (Steam), with a release on PlayStation and Xbox in Summer 2026.
title: iRacing Arcade - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Karen, a 3D action beat-em-up sandbox game developed by Sauce Studios. Players will embody a disgruntled Karen who's been denied service to her satisfaction, leaving rage to be the only acceptable response. Wreak havoc across the local mall, speak to managers, and destroy everything in sight with physics-driven attacks. Karen is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Karen - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for The Road, a co-op open-world driving horror game developed by Not Doppler. Players will take in the scenic yet haunting views of an eerie world in search of loot, friendship, and the thrill of escaping a menacing creature by the skin of their teeth. The Road is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Road - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Reconfigure, a puzzle-based first-person RPG shooter developed by Hapatus. Players will explore a starship to manipulate blocks to solve puzzles, harness new skills, and engage with deadly robots to survive while the ship reconfigures itself. Reconfigure is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Reconfigure - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Diamond Dynasty Updates Trailer for MLB The Show 26, the upcoming installment of the hit baseball simulation game developed by Sony San Diego. Players will be met with a plethora of updates to Diamond Dynasty with new challenges, collectibles, and customizations in the latest iteration of the mode. World Baseball Classic implementation, a revamped play-by-play, and more have all been added to Diamond Dynasty in MLB The Show 26, launching on March 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, with Early Access starting on March 9 with the Deluxe Edition.
title: MLB The Show 26 - Official Diamond Dynasty Updates Trailer

title: Capcom Spotlight - March 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Dangerous Horizons Expansion Gameplay Trailer for Icarus, an open-world sci-fi survival game developed by RocketWerkz. Players will take on a new expansion for the game, allowing players to venture to Elysium, a hazardous new map warped by radiation and exotic fallout. Progress through 17 new narrative missions packed with new species, gear, mounts, and more. The Dangerous Horizons Expansion for Icarus is launching on March 6 for PC (Steam).
title: Icarus - Official Dangerous Horizons Expansion Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for AGX GP, a fast-paced sci-fi anti-gravity racing game developed by Typ1 Games. Players will take on an array of tracks to overcome challenges and achieve intense speeds to win. Make use of abilities, precise adjustments at high speeds, and enter the flow state in AGX GP, coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: AGX GP - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Dreamtone, a 2D top-down adventure RPG developed by Not Gonna Miss It. Players will explore an 1980s Americana that's been rocked with a deep conspiracy. Meet a vibrant cast of characters and engage in deep turn-based combat in Dreamtone, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Dreamtone - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Phantom Lamb, a stealth story-driven psychological horror game developed by Grid Paper Studio. Players will survive an early-20th-century asylum as horrors remain to haunt the halls. Strategize on how to proceed, look out for guards, and make a great escape in Phantom Lamb, coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Phantom Lamb - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for SCP-9779-JP, a psychological first-person action horror game developed by Bipolarsoft. Players will explore a sprawling Japanese mansion alongside an underground SCP Laboratory full of frights and abstract imagery. Survive what lies ahead and deliver the SCP-9779-JP to safety in SCP-9779-JP, launching on April 9 for PC (Steam) with a demo available now.
title: SCP-9779-JP - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Season 2 Reloaded Zombies Trailer for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, the latest installment to the first-person shooter franchise developed by Treyarch. Players can get a look at the new Round-Based Zombies map coming to the game with Paradox Junction, a new Zombies map based on the acclaimed Nuketown map. Defeat the undead in Paradox Junction, coming to Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 on March 11 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Official Season 2 Reloaded Zombies Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Everhood Hunters announcement trailer for this upcoming roguelike that takes the series’ musical combat in a new direction with co-op and endlessly replayable runs. Everhood Hunters will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2027.

Team up with a friend to embark on a roguelite adventure set in the Everhood universe to seal the root of all evil by solving riddles. Navigate winding paths filled with battles, rewards, shops, rest points, elite encounters, and other mysterious events
title: Everhood Hunters - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the twisted animated Sol Cesto trailer for this tactical and frantic roguelite where mastering your luck is key. In Sol Cesto, choose a hero, upgrade them using cursed teeth and magical items, and descend to the bottom of an ever-changing dungeon. In this dark world, every action has consequences. Sol Cesto is leaving Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam on April 10, 2026.
title: Sol Cesto - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into combat in this latest Ledgerbound trailer for the upcoming single-player, narrative-driven tactical RPG set in a high fantasy world ruled by bureaucracy. Ledgerbound will be available on PC via Steam in 2026, and a demo will be available on March 6, 2026.

Life as an insurance adjuster was fantastic: overtime, exceeding quotas, denying claims and increasing profits for the Shareholders’ benefits. But when world-shattering tragedy strikes, it’s your turn to step onto the battlefield as a company-sponsored Hero. With a quest to fulfill, goals to hit, and a peculiar party of characters to join you in battle and get to know in a (HR-approved) dating simulator, overtime is looking likely.

#Ledgerbound #TacticalRPG
title: Ledgerbound - Official Combat Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at gameplay from Lunchbreak Tactics in this trailer for the upcoming no-timer strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. 

Draft cards, build absurd synergies, and min-max your squad, then battle other players asynchronously. 

Lunchbreak Tactics will be available on PC via Steam on April 28, 2026.

#LunchbreakTactics #AutoBattler
title: Lunchbreak Tactics - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 Gameplay Trailer for Atomic Heart, an open-world first-person action-adventure game developed by Mundfish. Players will experience the conclusion to the first part of the Atomic Heart storyline with the 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 that sees P-3 and the Twin traverse through the Crystal Complex to face CHAR-les. 

Take on enemy after enemy in flashy combat, leading to a face-off like no other in Facility 3826. 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 for Atomic Heart is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#AtomicHeart #FPS
title: Atomic Heart - Official 'Blood on Crystal' DLC #4 Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into the shoes of Samantha Burkhart as she seeks answers in her late father’s derelict amusement park. In each abandoned attraction lies a memory tied to her childhood, which players can unlock as they restore the park to its former glory. Watch the teaser trailer for The Amusement, an upcoming narrative VR adventure game. 

The Amusement will be available on Steam and Meta on April 16, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

#TheAmusement #VRGame
title: The Amusement - Official Release Date Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Worlds Upon the Wind trailer to learn about this roguelite deckbuilder game. Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations. Worlds Upon the Wind will be available on PC, and a Playtest is available now via Steam.

#WorldsUponTheWind #Deckbuilder
title: Worlds Upon the Wind - Official Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the VR Training Trailer for Death Stranding 2: On The Beach, the third-person action-adventure strand game developed by Kojima Productions. Players can take a break from connecting Australia to the Chiral Network by getting some VR Training in to hone in skills, test out new weapons and gear, and overcome a suite of different challenges all in virtual reality. 

Death Stranding 2: On The Beach is launching on March 19 for PC (Steam), with the game being available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#DeathStranding2 #ActionAdventure
title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Official VR Training Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Learn about the story, spirits, and more from KinForge in this narrative trailer for the upcoming co-op, creature-collector action RPG. In KinForge, every fusion of powers creates new experiences, wild combos, and the strength to fight against spreading Corruption. Forge bonds with Ancient Elementals, beings of the Mystic Realm, and restore a world on the brink of collapse. Join Seeker Games CCO and Co-Founder, Travis McGeathy, for a closer look at the story, and the trailer also showcases concept art! KinForge will be available on PC.

#KinForge #ActionRPG
title: KinForge - Official Narrative Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Seeker Games CCO and Co-Founder, Travis McGeathy, for a deep dive into the gameplay of KinForge in this latest trailer for the upcoming co-op, creature-collector action RPG. In KinForge, every fusion of powers creates new experiences, wild combos, and the strength to fight against spreading Corruption. 

Forge bonds with Ancient Elementals, beings of the Mystic Realm, and restore a world on the brink of collapse. The gameplay trailer focuses on combat and how finding elemental creatures unlocks power for your characters. KinForge will be available on PC.

#Kinforge #ActionRPG
title: KinForge - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Welcome aboard, agents! Here's your look at the Claim Denied announcement trailer for this upcoming cooperative comedy horror game set on a spaceship, where you are a special department of the Quark.Inc corporation, investigating a series of mysterious incidents. 

You can never predict which mission you'll get, or which role (Bureaucrat, Scout, Medic, or Engineer) will be crucial. Investigate crimes, fight bureaucracy, and don't take anything extra - or you'll be left empty-handed. Claim Denied will be available in PC Early Access.

#ClaimDenied #ComedyHorror
title: Claim Denied - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Story Trailer for Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure game developed by Big Bad Wolf. Players will investigate an underwater mining colony after losing contact in the Pacific Ocean. 

Explore an ancient sunken city and face the horrors alongside an AI companion. Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is launching on April 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#CthulhuTheCosmicAbyss #Horror
title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - Official Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the 'Cast & Character Dev Diary' Beyond the Light Episode 2 for 007 First Light, the upcoming action-adventure third-person James Bond game developed by IO Interactive. Players will get an in-depth look at the cast and characters from the upcoming title with two developers, Narrative & Cinematic Director Martin Emborg and Lead and Senior Character Artist Beatrice Harty, alongside Kiera Lester as Moneypenny and Alastair Mackenzie as Q.

Get the overview on how IO Interactive is setting out to color the characters of the James Bond origin story to life. 007 First Light is launching on May 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#007FirstLight #Action
title: 007 First Light - Official 'Cast & Character Dev Diary' Beyond the Light Episode 2
